source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4 with Figs. 9.14 and 9.15 (PDF 200-201).

blocks.text: Maan lein point charges q₁, q₂, q₃, …, qₙ kisi bhi shakal ki band (closed) surface ke andar kahin bhi rakhe hain (Fig. 9.14). Har charge q ka flux q/ε₀ hai, is liye band surface se kul flux:

blocks.alt: Be-qaida gulabi band surface jis ke andar saat chhote narangi point charges q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6 aur qn.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.14 (kitab ki Figure 9.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har charge apna flux q/ε₀ deta hai; kul flux sab ka jor (q₁ + q₂ + … + qₙ)/ε₀ = Q/ε₀ hai. Surface ke bahar wale charges kul flux mein kuch nahi jorte: un ki jo line andar aati hai wohi bahar nikal jati hai.

blocks.text_alt: φₑ = (1/ε₀) × (band surface ke andar kul charge)

blocks.text: Yahan Q = q₁ + q₂ + q₃ + … + qₙ band surface ke andar kul charge hai. Eq. 9.14 Gauss's law ki mathematical shakal hai. Lafzon mein:

blocks.title: Gauss's law
blocks.text: Kisi bhi band surface se kul electric flux us ke andar band kul charge ka 1/ε₀ guna hota hai.

Gauss's law se mukhtalif charge configurations (tarteeb) ki electric intensity nikali ja sakti hai. Har dafa ek imaginary (khayali) band surface lete hain jo us point se guzarti hai jahan field nikalni ho. Is surface ko Gaussian surface kehte hain. Ise aise chuna jata hai ke us se flux aasani se nikal sake.
Misal ke taur par, ab us sphere ke bahar kisi point par field nikalte hain jis par charge q rakha ho.

Radius R ka conducting sphere lein jis par charge q hai. Hum jaante hain ke saara charge sphere ki surface par barabar phaila hota hai (Fig. 9.15). Sphere har taraf se ek jaisa hai (spherical symmetry), is liye field har jagah radial (centre se seedha bahar) hai aur us ki magnitude (miqdar) sirf centre (beech ka point) se faasle r par depend karti hai. Yani conductor ke saath concentric kisi bhi sphere par E har jagah barabar hai. Is liye Gaussian surface ke liye radius r (R se bara) ka imaginary sphere lete hain.
Gaussian sphere ka area 4πr² hai aur us par E har jagah barabar hai, is liye poori surface se kul flux:

blocks.alt: Andar ka circle (conducting sphere, radius R cyan mein) jis ki surface par + charges, aur bara concentric circle (Gaussian sphere, radius r). Magenta lines dono se bahar radial, conductor ke andar dashed.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.15 (kitab ki Figure 9.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Conductor ka saara charge us ki surface par hota hai aur andar field zero hai; andar ki dashed lakeerein sirf yeh dikhati hain ke bahar field aisi hai jaise saara charge centre par ho. Radius r ka Gaussian sphere lene se E = q/(4πε₀r²) milta hai.
Yeh batata hai ke sphere ke bahar har point par field waisi hi hai jaise saara charge sphere ke centre par jama ho. Sphere ke bilkul bahar, jahan r = R:
Vector shakal mein r̂ field E ki direction (centre se bahar) batata hai.

blocks.caption: Gauss's law kaise lagayein (khulasa)
rows: Us point se guzarne wali Gaussian surface chunein
R se bare radius r ka concentric sphere
E × 4πr² (E radial aur har jagah barabar)
Flux ko (andar ka charge)/ε₀ ke barabar rakhein
E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²): jaise saara charge centre par ho

blocks.prompt: Agar rubber ka charged ghubbara (balloon) gol ho aur charge us ki surface par barabar phaila ho, to kya andar E zaroor zero hai (constructed response 9.2)? Positive (musbat) charge q ki field mein ek be-charge conducting khokhla (hollow) sphere rakha hai; shell se kul (net) flux kitna hai (constructed response 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Ghubbare ke andar banayi gayi gol Gaussian surface koi charge nahi gherti, is liye us se flux zero hai; aur symmetry ki wajah se E us poori surface par barabar hogi, is liye andar E khud zero honi chahiye. Be-charge shell se net flux zero hai: shell koi net charge nahi gherta, is liye jitni field lines andar aati hain utni hi bahar nikal jati hain.

items: Gauss's law: φₑ = Q/ε₀ (9.14); kisi band surface se kul flux andar band charge ka 1/ε₀ guna.
Gaussian surface: us point se guzarne wali imaginary band surface jahan field nikalni ho.
Charged conducting sphere: charge surface par; bahar E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²), jaise charge centre par ho; bilkul bahar E = (1/4πε₀)(q/R²) (9.15).
